authorization: A bounded deterministic correctness prerequisite to the eligible J6B replacement-pilot registration; no stochastic pilot or J6 reinterpretation is authorized here.
observed_counterexample: With one public odd syndrome at round 1 followed by an even full snapshot at round 2, the E1 public callback emits defer_temporal_boundary then action, but evaluate_schedule_arm unconditionally fails the complete history on the earlier defer. The current caller therefore cannot realize the J6A later-request reconciliation semantics.
question: Can the integrated caller treat a digest-bound temporal handoff as a no-physics deferral, supersede it only with a later causal full-snapshot spatial action, and retain persistent or conflicting handoffs as unconditional failures?
smallest_claim: Four deterministic fixtures can validate the ledger-to-physical-action transition and denominator semantics; they cannot establish stochastic risk or fault tolerance.

frozen_model.geometry: Paper-normalized periodic D4 honeycomb L=2, five readout rounds, four hidden transitions.
frozen_model.public_input: The already validated J6A E1 signal-only full-binary causal first record and digest-bound odd-snapshot handoff; no private or future field.
frozen_model.physical_action: Only an even full-snapshot D4FluxActionV1 is a physical cumulative Pauli-frame estimate. A handoff has no post-flux second observation and no physical correction.
frozen_model.ledger_rule: Canonical same-round duplicate handoffs collapse if their public snapshot and temporal labels agree. An earlier handoff may be superseded by a later causal even full-snapshot action. A terminal unresolved handoff or conflicting same-round snapshot fails closed.
frozen_model.loss_and_denominator: Unconditional Boolean-union loss and exactly one row per mode/schedule/history remain unchanged; unresolved or malformed handoffs count as logical failure, never disappearing.
frozen_model.private_boundary: Physical state, support, hidden relation, winding and logical truth are unavailable to public handoff and action construction; private scoring occurs only after a real action.

fixture_matrix.required: Earlier defer produces no post-flux record or physical edge; a later full-snapshot even action supersedes it and the zero-physical deterministic history scores without a fabricated failure.
A terminal odd handoff remains failed_closed, denominator_included and logical_failure=true.
Identical public defer callbacks collapse; a conflicting same-round action or token fails closed.
All eight mode/schedule rows remain unconditional; replay and private-sidecar/future-only invariance remain intact on the deterministic fixture.

acceptance: All four fixtures pass through the E1 public callback and integrated unconditional caller.
Only non-handoff actions generate second records or physical corrections; canonical commit count excludes handoffs.
Persistent and conflicting handoffs remain unconditional failures; no hidden/future fields enter public actions.
All Lab 005 regression tests pass, and frozen J6 raw and analysis SHA-256 values remain unchanged.
stop_rule: At the first fixture or regression failure, record the failing gate and keep J6B stochastic registration blocked. Passing R0 permits only the separate J6B pilot registration; it does not start histories or arm analysis.

post_execution_budget_scope_clarificatio.trigger: The original budget and acceptance list both required the 158-test Lab regression suite but did not explicitly separate its repeated deterministic tests from the 32-arm new-fixture cap.
post_execution_budget_scope_clarificatio.interpretation: The 32-arm cap applies to the four newly registered R0 fixtures (22 deterministic arm evaluations by fixture expansion). The separately required 158-test existing Lab regression suite is a source-compatibility gate under the same 120-second runtime cap, not production arm sampling.
post_execution_budget_scope_clarificatio.scope_or_result_change: None: no stochastic history, production arm, bootstrap, fixture, acceptance gate, or runtime cap was added after seeing results.

execution.claim_boundary: Deterministic no-physics deferral and later even full-snapshot supersession only; no schedule-risk or fault-tolerance evidence.
